exposure: time to full feeds with fortification
gestational age at birth: <= 28 weeks, 29-30 weeks, 31-32 weeks
cohort: 57 infants <= 32 weeks' gestation or <= 1250 g at birth
finding: Metabolic bone disease was observed in 100% of extremely preterm babies and 69% of very preterm babies, with caffeine, steroid, and furosemide use significantly impacting its development.
